tail.why_not_a_dissolve: the cut schema builds butt-joined V1 segments and literal-black gaps; it has no dissolve, and Resolve exposes no scriptable transition or clip fade (only Text+ opacity keyframes). So the piece takes the family's other measured device - the hard cut two of the five deliverables use - at Taurus's own instant.
tail.applause: no applause tail in the picture; the crowd is audible under black only, which is what the deliverable's own audio does (rms at end-8 s -28.3 dB, never digital silence)
